reviews.x: As a fan of Marvel, and an EMJ product user for a few years, I got pretty excited about this. I've been using citrus scrub body wash for the past while, but my fiancé kept on using it. I figured the large box would keep us stocked up for a bit. So far my favorite is the Wakanda Herbs- subtle, but the scent is really good. I hope that it isn't a limited edition or else I might need to order a few more bottles.
This is how the product arrived. Only 2 of the 4 bottles were included, and they were just thrown in a box.

I bought these for my son as a Christmas present. The box itself is sturdy and the artwork is awesome. The smell is out of this world, especially the Captain America citrus one!! I am probably going to buy my husband some of the other products after smelling all of these. This is our first time buying every man jack products but definitely won't be the last!

Bought this set for my son. Absolutely love it! Favorite scents are Iron Man & Black Panther. If you like a slight fruity scent Spider-Man would do. Captain America is okay but wouldn’t buy it alone. A great set to give as a gift for those Marvel lover’s! Boxing is very nice with great detail.

I ordered the collectors edition set and got THIS... 2 of the same body washes in a freaking plastic bag... 2 days before Christmas when this is supposed to be a Christmas gift!!! SO aggravated. I expected more from this brand.

My kids love the soap, although I thought they would want to try them all, but the only want to use their favorite characters, Spider-Man and Black Panther. The box is pretty cool, too. I wanted them to use the box to put their Avengers toys in them, but my 3 year old son likes to dump those out and put the soaps back in it, in order.
These scents are amazing. This will be my go-to set for the foreseeable future!

I wouldn't call this a great value but I would call it a great gift. The young man for whom it was purchased absolutely loved it. Thankfully, I didn't experience leaking bottles as described on other reviews. Mine arrived well-packaged and in a great box for gifting. The recipient favors two scents but said they were all good. Well satisfied!

reviews.t: Great for adults, but careful for kids and sensitive skin
reviews.x: Scent was good, especially the Wakanda one. I let my kids try them since they saw the Avengers on the bottle.  Unfortunately, they started to get itchy after each use. I made sure they rinsed off properly but it still happened. I did not have any issues as an adult, but be careful when letting those with sensitive skin (or kids) use this.

reviews.t: Lids were lose on all four bottles
reviews.x: These four body washes all smell really great.  I wanted to give them to my son for Christmas in the box they came in.  When I opened the Amazon packing box, body wash was everywhere.  It was on the other gift that shipped with it.  I opened the box that contained the four bottles and noticed that all four lids were lose.  Not sure how this happened.  I have had to rinse and dry each bottle.  I will not be able to use the nice box they're supposed to come with.  The other gift that shipped with

I didn't listen to reviews and bought anyways for one of my husband's Christmas gifts because he lives Marvel. I'm so upset I want to cry that this is now ruined. Soap leaked everywhere I tried to clean it up but there was no saving it. The black panther bottle top was broke and won't shut at all and all the bottles are now practically half way gone. I wish I would have listened to the reviews. Smdh!

I gave it to my son-in-law as a gift for his work promotion & he loved it! He says it smells great, but he's going to keep it with his marvel collectibles.  Now I think I need to buy him something he can actually use :)
Product was delivered leaking. All four bottles were leaking. So a body wash mix was leaking all over my other amazon items i ordered. Big mess, but otherwise each one has a uniquely decent scent.
I got this for my son for Christmas. It looks very special to open its perfect! The bottles are a lot bigger than I thought and is very good quality. My little man is going to love it !
Absolutely love these. I am a woman with children and we rotate using these b/c they smell so great. Spider-man, Ironman and Black Panther are the top 3 from greatest to least *
My son was obsessed he used it from his most favorite character they didn’t last long because he kept taking bubble bath 😂 ….100% would buy again

reviews.t: Items smell great cool set only issue one bottle was leaking when shipped
reviews.x: I love this product but wanted the collection and my favorite Spider-Man was leaking on box and from bottle!  Top of bottle has a crack in it!
We already liked these products. The superhero thing just made it go from utilitarian to a cool extra gift item.

reviews.t: Great set for the Marvel Man in your life!
reviews.x: One of the bottles leaked a bit into the box, but not badly enough to return. Really nice set!
My son really is enjoying the soap. One of my best buys for him
gift for my boyfriend he loves it so much they all smell great
I got this for my dad for Christmas and he loved it!

I love this body wash ! I ordered it for my bf as a surprise , he’s so into marvel . The smell of each one smells amazing ! Unfortunately my box was damaged , as you can see in the one pic . It’s not super big , but still sucks . Some of the body wash was spilled out of the top , but we just wiped it off ! But other than that I highly recommend !

reviews.t: Captain America scent is different (Not Winter Mint)
reviews.x: My husband got this set for Christmas last year and loved the set. He wanted the set again, and his favorite was Captain America Winter Mint. Although the name of this product says Winter Mint, the Captain America has been changed to Citrus Flight. Disappointed and wanted to warn others in case you also liked a particular scent.

reviews.t: Nice gift set, every fragrance is Amazing!
reviews.x: I purchased this set as a gift, it is absolutely amazing. Keepsake box is a collectors item, very nice fragrance. What I dislike is that each bottle should have a protective seal to prevent spillage/ leakage before shipping. Otherwise I highly recommend this product.  You will not be disappointed. Love it

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scents, calling them amazing or great, with Wakanda, Captain America citrus, Iron Man, Black Panther, and Spider-Man specifically mentioned as favorites.
Many customers describe the set as a great gift, especially for Marvel fans, praising the sturdy, detailed box and artwork.
A recurring complaint is that bottles leaked during shipping, sometimes ruining the packaging or other items.
Several reviewers report receiving an incomplete or incorrect order, such as missing bottles or the wrong set in a plastic bag instead of the collector's edition box.
Some reviewers note the product is pricey or not a great value, though they still consider it a good gift.
